description: This file defines an interface 'IStreamFilter' for filtering stream items in Orleans streaming system, along with an internal implementation 'NoOpStreamFilter' that always allows delivery.

classes.name: NoOpStreamFilter
classes.description: An internal implementation of IStreamFilter that always returns true for ShouldDeliver, indicating no filtering.

methods.name: ShouldDeliver
methods.description: Determines whether a stream item should be delivered based on filtering logic. The NoOpStreamFilter implementation returns true unconditionally.
